_about: Golden cases for configuration loading and command admission (config/allowlist in both editions). Each case is a configuration document (null for the built-in defaults), the value of HOME (null when the command does not use ~), and a command; the expectation is the admission, the refusal, or the configuration error. Configuration errors name the file <config>; YAML errors are prefixed 'invalid YAML: '. Both unit-test suites load this file.
